attchmntText: Shiv Aum Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Shiv Aum Steels Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026. The advertisements were published in The Financial Express in English and The Pratahkal in Marathi. The financial results are available on the company website and stock exchange websites. Aadi Industries Limited reported a net loss of 4.78 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Yamini Investments Company Limited reported net profit of 20.74 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Om Freight Forwarders Limited adopted its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at its Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Sarveshwar Foods Limited reported consolidated profit after tax of 1660.73 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Annapurna Swadisht Limited filed its Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Reilly Homes Realty Private Limited reported net loss of 30.48 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Shiv Aum Steels Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 68002000 equity shares of Rs. 2 each.
Shiv Aum Steels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
